checks.name: Future asset compilation

requirements.description: Future deliverable: compilable MuJoCo MJCF with relative mesh resources and locatable component, joint and interaction mappings. This task delivers specifications only.

requirements.contact_solver: Pin and record MuJoCo version and solver settings before running; missing configuration gives invalid_test.
requirements.reason: Initial quasi-static proxy conditions, not manufacturer operating speeds or verified material properties. This is not a manufacturer tolerance.

asset_specific.note: Tilt is a handling proxy; no actual fluid removal measurement.

T-CASE-0.initial: Tube upright in verified fixture; independent column above opening.
T-CASE-0.action: Lower column to rim, release for 5 s, remove 40 mm along tube axis.
T-CASE-0.observable: Rim support and open space below outlet.
T-CASE-0.pass_condition: Column supported with tilt <=2 degrees and drift <=1 mm; outlet-bottom clearance positive; removal does not lift collector >1 mm.
T-CASE-0.note: Proxy acceptance conditions,not manufacturer tolerances; source requirements retain their own provenance.

T-CASE-1.initial: Column in collector; external waste-present flag true.
T-CASE-1.action: Attempt emptying before column removal, then remove column and tilt tube 120 degrees for 3 s, return upright and reinsert.
T-CASE-1.observable: Relative component trajectories and external protocol ordering.
T-CASE-1.pass_condition: Premature emptying flagged invalid; proper sequence accepted; column never enters waste-receiver region and tube returns within2 degrees upright without unintended overlap >0.2 mm. Empty flag is an event proxy, not measured fluid absence.
T-CASE-1.note: Proxy acceptance conditions,not manufacturer tolerances; source requirements retain their own provenance.

T-LOAD.condition: No errors, resources resolved and all states finite.

target.description: Future deliverable: compilable MuJoCo MJCF with relative mesh resources and locatable component, joint and interaction mappings. This task delivers specifications only.

T-STRUCT.condition: Every critical component and connection conforms.

T-CASE-0.condition: Column supported with tilt <=2 degrees and drift <=1 mm; outlet-bottom clearance positive; removal does not lift collector >1 mm.

target.initial: Tube upright in verified fixture; independent column above opening.
target.action: Lower column to rim, release for 5 s, remove 40 mm along tube axis.
target.observable: Rim support and open space below outlet.
target.pass_condition: Column supported with tilt <=2 degrees and drift <=1 mm; outlet-bottom clearance positive; removal does not lift collector >1 mm.
target.note: Proxy acceptance conditions,not manufacturer tolerances; source requirements retain their own provenance.

T-CASE-1.condition: Premature emptying flagged invalid; proper sequence accepted; column never enters waste-receiver region and tube returns within2 degrees upright without unintended overlap >0.2 mm. Empty flag is an event proxy, not measured fluid absence.

target.initial: Column in collector; external waste-present flag true.
target.action: Attempt emptying before column removal, then remove column and tilt tube 120 degrees for 3 s, return upright and reinsert.
target.observable: Relative component trajectories and external protocol ordering.
target.pass_condition: Premature emptying flagged invalid; proper sequence accepted; column never enters waste-receiver region and tube returns within2 degrees upright without unintended overlap >0.2 mm. Empty flag is an event proxy, not measured fluid absence.
target.note: Proxy acceptance conditions,not manufacturer tolerances; source requirements retain their own provenance.
